'''Chiron Drebbick''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] [[Infiltration]] agent serving the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the years following the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]. He was operating on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Seikosha/Legends|Seikosha]] as the chief [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] of [[Lydenn Carridon]].
